project: LE SONGE BLEU DE L'HUMBLE ABIME
_note: 5 plans de 8 s = 40 s, extrait condense de TOXICOSQUEROS, un chanteur par plan. Graphies reprises telles quelles des prises validees a l'oreille : ne pas les « corriger ».
suffix: Cinematic, 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, thick atmospheric haze, high contrast, desaturated steel-blue base with toxic green and violet practical lights, fine film grain, handheld with slow drift. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark.

personnages.P1: a Black man in his 30s with shoulder-length locs, dark grey hoodie under a black tactical plate carrier, sweat on his face
personnages.P2: a Black man in his 30s, very short hair, blue-grey hoodie under a black plate carrier
personnages.P3: an East Asian woman in her 30s, tight cornrow braids, glossy black leather jacket, layered silver chains, sharp winged eyeliner
personnages.P4: an East Asian man in his 30s, black hoodie, thick silver curb chain, stubble
personnages.P5: a Black man in his 30s, short twisted locs, wooden bead necklace with a small cross, black tactical vest

shots.scene: Medium close-up of a Black man in his 30s with shoulder-length locs, dark grey hoodie under a black tactical plate carrier, standing in thick white smoke lit by a single vertical neon tube. He sings straight to camera. Slow push in.
shots.dialogue: Néo-chamans sans conscience, drogue tes enfants à l'ayahuasca et à l'iboga. Même combat, Aztèques réincarnés.
shots.dialogue_phon: Néo-shamanes sans conssience, drogue tes enfants à l'ayawaska et à l'iboga. Même combat, Aztèques réincarnés.
shots.cue: He raps in French straight to camera

shots.scene: Medium shot of an East Asian woman in her 30s with tight cornrow braids, glossy black leather jacket and layered silver chains, in a flooded underground corridor lit by green and violet neon, hanging roots dripping overhead. She sings straight to camera, water rippling at her boots.
shots.dialogue: La science te fait peur. Ennemis de l'intelligence et du sens critique. Fixé dans le temps, tes armes sont la haine et la soumission chimique.
shots.dialogue_phon: La syanss te fait peur. Ennemis de l'intelligence et du sens critique. Fixé dans le temps, tes armes sont la haine et la soumission shimique.
shots.cue: She raps in French straight to camera

shots.scene: A Black man in his 30s with very short hair, blue-grey hoodie under a black plate carrier, sings in a pitch-black space hung with red and white chains, hard red key light from one side, cold blue rim from the other, smoke drifting. He leans slowly into the lens.
shots.dialogue: Dissimule les méfaits derrière le voile du mensonge. Invisible aux yeux de tous, manipule les foules dans l'ombre de l'aberration.
shots.dialogue_phon: Dissimule les méfè derrière le voile du mensonge. Invisible aux yeux de tous, manipule les foules dans l'ombre de l'aberration.
shots.cue: He raps in French straight to camera

shots.scene: An East Asian man in his 30s, black hoodie and thick silver curb chain, sings in a derelict daylight factory hall, broken windows, dust hanging in the air. Cold grey daylight, slow handheld drift.
shots.dialogue: Organise et ose appeler les cérémonies, brise les participants à cette séance d'empoisonnement. Faim, soif, privation de sommeil.
shots.dialogue_phon: Organise et ose appeler les cérémonies, brise les participants à cette séanss d'empoisonnement. Faim, soif, privation de sommeil.
shots.cue: He raps in French straight to camera

shots.scene: A Black man in his 30s with short twisted locs, a wooden bead necklace with a small cross and a black tactical vest, sings in a dark hall hung with heavy broken chains, tropical foliage crowding both edges of frame, violet and white smoke rolling past. Slow push in until his face fills the frame.
shots.dialogue: Messager de l'apocalypse, je me porte partie civile. Tu vas devoir répondre de tes crimes.
shots.dialogue_phon: Messager de l'apocalipse, je me porte partie civile. Tu vas devoir répondre de tes crimes.
shots.cue: He raps in French straight to camera
